_comment: Captured 2026-09-04 from the Boxtal SANDBOX (api.boxtal.build) by the §14.3 probe. The two .json bodies are byte-for-byte what Boxtal POSTed (user-agent boxtal-webhook); the signatures are the x-bxt-signature header values Boxtal sent with them. The secret is the SANDBOX subscription secret, test-only, never used in production. HMAC-SHA256(secret, raw body) encoded as lowercase hex reproduces each header exactly.

fixtures.note: Second tracking event for that order (16:40:03+02:00), history of two ANNOUNCED entries, location « Centre Courrier 34 »; delivered on Boxtal's retry after the first tunnel was unreachable.
